title: 030 — Delivery confirmation for a two-parcel international order

plan.situation: Kael Rook wants us to confirm that both parcels of order VEL-030-26 have arrived and to close the order. Parcel A (VR-030-A) has a matched handover record: POD-030-A, handed over 2026-10-14 07:55 +01:00, receiver mark KR-30. Parcel B (VR-030-B) only shows broker_release at 07:40 +01:00. Its last physical scan was at the broker holding depot at 07:10 +01:00, there is no delivery handover, and the customer says they cannot find it. Guide OC30 says an order is complete only when every parcel has matched handover evidence, and that broker release is not a delivery.

facts.fact: VEL-030-26 is a two-parcel order: A = VR-030-A, B = VR-030-B. The stored trace channel is trace@vellora.example
Under guide OC30, completion needs matched handover evidence for each parcel. Broker release is a processing status, not a physical delivery. Merchant care handles any order-level remedy
VR-030-A was handed over on 2026-10-14 at 07:55 +01:00 at 9 Myrtle Quay, Rosemere, receiver mark KR-30 (record POD-030-A)
VR-030-B: broker_release at 07:40 +01:00, last physical scan at the broker holding depot at 07:10 +01:00, delivery_handover=null
The reconciliation desk confirms VR-030-A is matched and that the record has no last-mile receipt for VR-030-B
The customer received one box labelled VR-030-A and cannot find a second package at the receiving desk

missing_information: Where VR-030-B physically is now, and whether it has been handed to last-mile
Whether a last-mile delivery for VR-030-B has been planned
risk_flags: The customer is asking for the order to be closed as delivered when one parcel has no handover evidence. Closing it would hide a possible loss
The customer's identity is asserted by email only. Only order-status information already known to them is shared
No ETA or delivery outcome for VR-030-B is promised

authority_map.controls: Finding VR-030-B and providing a physical scan or handover evidence
Order closure, which needs matched handover evidence for each parcel
Any order-level remedy, if one is needed later
Confirming whether they received each parcel

wait_check.new_since_last_promise: The desk has made no earlier promise. E03, E05 and E06 are new facts: B has no handover and the customer has not found B

plan.decision_summary: Do not close VEL-030-26 as delivered. Ask Vellora trace to find VR-030-B from its last physical scan at the broker holding depot, and tell the customer that only VR-030-A is confirmed delivered.
plan.rationale: Guide OC30 requires matched handover evidence for each parcel. VR-030-B has only a broker release, which is a processing status, and no handover. The customer also says they have not received it. The right next step is a physical trace with the carrier's trace team on the stored channel. The customer asked directly, so they get a factual reply that makes no promises.

actions.subject: Trace request: VR-030-B (order VEL-030-26), no handover after broker release
actions.body:
Hello Vellora trace,

Please locate parcel VR-030-B (order VEL-030-26, parcel 2 of 2). The record shows its last physical scan at the broker holding depot at 2026-10-14 07:10 +01:00 and broker_release at 07:40 +01:00. There is no delivery handover and no last-mile receipt. The receiver reports that only VR-030-A arrived (POD-030-A, 07:55 +01:00, mark KR-30) and that no second package is at the receiving desk.

Please send today (2026-10-14) a current physical scan for VR-030-B, plus handover evidence if it has been handed to last-mile. If it cannot be found, please tell us so it can go to investigations. Under guide OC30 the order stays open until each parcel has matched handover evidence.

Thank you,
Rivet Delivery Desk
actions.purpose: Get a physical scan or handover evidence for parcel B from the carrier's trace team

actions.subject: Your order VEL-030-26: one of two parcels confirmed delivered
actions.body:
Hello Kael,

Thank you for checking. We can confirm that parcel VR-030-A was delivered on 14 October 2026 at 07:55 (UK time). We cannot close the order yet. The second parcel, VR-030-B, shows as 'released', but that is a customs processing step, not a delivery, and we have no record of it being handed over. We have asked the carrier's trace team to find VR-030-B and will update you once they reply. We cannot give a delivery time until they confirm where it is. If VR-030-B turns up at your receiving desk in the meantime, please reply to let us know.

Rivet Delivery Desk

Not treating broker release as delivery
Not promising an ETA, delivery outcome, refund or replacement for VR-030-B: no owner has confirmed any
Not contacting merchant care yet: no order-level remedy is due until the trace result is known
plan.follow_up: At 2026-10-14 17:00 +01:00, check for a physical scan or handover evidence for VR-030-B from Vellora trace. If there is a handover with matched receipt, the order can be closed under OC30. If it is still at the depot, ask for a last-mile plan. If there is no scan or no reply, move to investigations, and later to merchant care for any order-level remedy.

review_rounds.plan_summary: Do not close VEL-030-26 as delivered. Ask Vellora trace to find VR-030-B from its last physical scan at the broker holding depot, and tell the customer that only VR-030-A is confirmed delivered.

review.summary: I approve the plan. It correctly refuses to close VEL-030-26 under OC30, because broker release is not delivery and VR-030-B has no handover. It sends the trace request to Vellora trace on the stored channel and gives the customer a factual update that promises nothing. The lint flag is a false positive: the record backs "was delivered" for VR-030-A with a matched handover (POD-030-A, receiver mark KR-30, confirmed in E06).

issues.problem: The customer message calls 'released' a customs processing step and gives the time as 'UK time'. The record only says broker release is a processing status, and it gives the +01:00 offset without naming a timezone.
issues.fix: Describe it as 'a broker processing step, not a delivery' and write the time as 07:55 (+01:00), or as the time shown on the delivery record.

issues.problem: The lint warning on 'was delivered' (action 1) needs no change, because VR-030-A has a matched handover record. This note is only to clear the lint warning.
issues.fix: No change needed. Keep the delivery claim limited to VR-030-A, as the draft already does.
